records.source_title: QD OLED Is Better Than WOLED
records.author: @MichalHrubon
records.text:
I bought the ASUS ROG Strix XG27AQWMG Tandem WOLED and returned it after just one day. After only 30 minutes of use, I noticed very noticeable vertical banding across the screen, especially on the right side. It was clearly visible not just on grey test patterns, but also during normal gaming (Diablo III) and even on the Windows desktop. Once I noticed it, I couldn’t unsee it. Extremely disappointing for a premium OLED monitor. This was my experience with my particular unit, but I definitely wouldn’t accept this level of image quality.

Now I'll trybto find great qd oled
